label: Bundle Offer
purpose: Offer a discounted multi-unit or multi-product bundle to increase order value
_notes:
type='main' ties the bundle to the page's main Add to Cart button; type='separate' gives it its own Add to Cart button. button_label only applies when type='separate'. title_text is the block heading (e.g. 'BUY X & GET Y'). total_price_text/total_price_benefit are short inline_richtext labels shown in the price footer (only relevant when show_footer is true) — inline_richtext must NOT be wrapped in

tags. displayed_free_price_text is shown instead of a price when an item in the bundle is free (e.g. 'FREE'). The block also has up to 3 product slots (product_1/2/3) with their own descriptions and per-item discounts — these reference specific products the merchant picks in the theme editor and are intentionally excluded since the AI has no way to know real product handles; the total bundle's percentage_discount/fixed_amount_discount are pricing configuration, not copy, and are excluded for the same reason a discount code would be. All sizing, color, border and image-display settings are pure visual layout and excluded.
